Mientras buscaban los mensajes de compra, el altavoz anunció la llegada del tren. Clara explicó que había elegido Valparaíso porque quería visitar a su prima. Martín, en cambio, tenía una reunión familiar en Concepción. Aunque los dos habían hablado del viaje, ninguno había revisado los detalles con cuidado.

—¿Y ahora qué hacemos? —preguntó Clara.

to miss out on or lose; pierdas is a subjunctive form after a concern about a possible result
mistake; something done incorrectly
to ask; preguntamos here is a suggestion: “let’s ask”
office; here, a station service counter or office
before; introduces an action that should happen first
to get on or board; here, to board the train
to nod in agreement; asintió describes a completed response
to walk; caminaron describes a completed movement
toward; indicates the direction of movement
information counter; mesón is a regional word for a counter or service desk
to begin to; introduces the start of an action
to stop or come to a stop; reflexive here, as the train slows and stops
on arriving; a compact way to say “when they arrived”
to find or encounter; encontraron describes what they came across
several; more than a few, but not specified exactly
person; a human being
to keep on or continue; seguía means the action was still happening
to move forward; here, to progress as time passes
